newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi shares dip in active trade in the week.
newsitem.headline: Saudi shares dip in active trade in the week.

text.p: Saudi shares dipped in the week to Thursday as the value and volume of stocks traded inched higher, official figures released on Sunday showed.

The Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency (SAMA) said turnover rose to 5.28 million shares from 4.34 million a week earlier. The value of traded stocks firmed to 926.3 million riyals ($247 million) from 745.4 million.
SAMA, quoted by the Saudi Press Agency, said shares of 59 companies changed hands over the week. It said only two stocks gained ground, while 55 dipped and two remained unchanged.
The agency said the service sector dominated the market, with 2.4 million shares worth 140.7 million riyals traded. ($1=3.75 riyals)
